stem.text: Electron micrographs may show large numbers of ribosomes forming chains along mRNA molecules.
What is the advantage of this arrangement, compared to when ribosomes appear singly on the mRNA?

A.text: Different polypeptides can be produced simultaneously.

B.text: Fewer tRNA molecules are required to translate the polypeptide.

C.text: Large polypeptide chains can be produced.

D.text: Polypeptides can be produced more rapidly.
